project_description: leafcutter — a domain-agnostic agent/skill/workflow package that installs the full AI-assisted dev workflow (agents, skills, hooks, ticket lifecycle) into any project. Edit one JSON config file, run build.py, and the complete system is generated.
common_commands: python leafcutter-ai/scripts/build.py --target-dir . | python -m pytest leafcutter-ai/tests/ -v | python leafcutter-ai/scripts/package_audit.py | python leafcutter-ai/scripts/roadmap_query.py --current-outcome | python leafcutter-ai/scripts/build.py --validate-only | python leafcutter-ai/scripts/build.py --target-dir . --seed-docs
architecture_overview: leafcutter-ai/ is the portable package. scripts/commit_guardian/ and scripts/doc_compliance/ are quality-gate hook suites. leafcutter-ai/tickets/ holds the ticket lifecycle. .claude/ contains generated agents, skills, hooks, and commands.

testing_context.test_output_rules: Never write to project dirs; use tmp_path or /tmp
